scope: Real planner, merger, canonical persistence, compact parser and expansion with fictional candidate/JD data only
failures: New plans omit the review policy; unknown policy versions silently pass
A report candidate omits either answer, supplies unsupported fields or exceeds the concern limit
A rejection reason cites another JD, an invented resume quote or a profile/custom-rule source instead of cv.md
A documented gap has no resume quote; a missing-documentation concern is presented as proven inability
No evidence-supported rejection reason causes invented concerns instead of an honest empty list
Multiline quotes and Markdown metacharacters damage the report or escape their evidence context
Reports below threshold acquire reports or review payloads; new reviews change scores or decisions
The answers disappear during canonical persistence, parsing or report expansion, or appear twice
Historical v8 reports are backfilled or fail inspection because they have no review
Production candidate files, reports, Career-Ops system code or shared dependencies change
acceptance: A unique .local artifact directory retains CLI logs, assertions, fictional inputs, compact and expanded reports; browser QA uses an isolated data root
